title: Signal & Noise
briefing: Value Vera trusts her oscillators. Momentum Max trusts his averages. One of these charts is about to trend and the other is stuck in a range. Bring the right tool to each.
objective: Use trend tools in a trend and RSI in a range; know when each one misleads.
debrief: Lumen Bikes' sold-out commuter bike (day 5) and raised delivery forecast (day 14) drove a strong trend, with RSI above 70 for most of two weeks: oscillator signals said "sell" far too early. Tidal Power stayed in a range; its sharp dips on days 4 and 13 pushed RSI under 30 and bounced, while Momentum Max's average signals bought the bounces late and sold the dips. The battery shortage (day 26) ended the Lumen Bikes trend and the price cap (day 33) broke the Tidal Power range. A disciplined player held Lumen Bikes above its 20-day EMA, sold when it closed below, and bought Tidal Power only near the range floor.

news.headline: Lumen Bikes warns of a battery shortage

news.headline: Lumen Bikes' battery shortage to last into next quarter
news.body: The company says some orders will be delayed by up to two months.

news.headline: Regulator caps the price renewable producers can charge
